identification: Two cast iron treadle sewing machine bases (stands only, no tops or machines). Right: Singer base, 'SINGER' cast in the cross-stretcher, lattice/wave end frames with sphinx-style medallions, large flywheel, lattice treadle; rusty brown, bare metal, unpainted. Left: unnamed black-painted base with scrolled top rails, heart/swan-neck cross brace with oval centre, flywheel, lattice treadle and a wooden pitman rod; German/Continental style (form like Wertheim or Frister & Rossmann type stands), maker not visible. Both look complete with treadles and wheels.
